findings.desc: Docs/code naming drift: the hardening plan implementation boundary tells readers to register proof surfaces through `ArtifactDefinition` and evaluate gate claims through `ClaimPolicy` at docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:58-60, but the current registry exports `ProofSurfaceDefinition` and `ProofClaimPolicy` at packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:122-144. This can misdirect follow-up implementation work even though the Authority/production scope rules themselves remain correctly conservative.

M7 adversarial matrix coverage is incomplete. The plan requires executable regressions for wrong story id, wrong target phase, wrong key id, bad signature, stale current-state green, red/green command mismatch, candidate mutation, bootstrap noise, and matrix-gap policy exceptions (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:431-447, 560-584). The two proof admissibility suites pass, but packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.ts only covers reserved metadata, semantic tamper, strict shape, diagnostics, legacy classification, handoff overclaim, and enforce blocking; packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.ts covers stale material and broad consumer/producer mismatch. In packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts, several specific reason codes are enumerated but no evaluator branch or test assertion produces story_mismatch, gate_phase_mismatch, red_green_command_mismatch, matrix_gap_unwaived, bootstrap_noise, command_spec_digest_mismatch, or stale_hash_tuple. Commands run: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs all passed, confirming this is a coverage gap rather than a failing test.
